objectives.summary: The project 'Khat' aims to create a digital messaging platform that prioritizes privacy and facilitates meaningful communication, particularly for users as young as 12. It seeks to normalize letter writing as a form of communication and provide a personal hotline experience for users to share their feelings with trusted individuals.

The app aims to help kids convey their feelings to parents, teachers, and mentors.
Khat values a person's privacy more than anything else.
The app is designed for longer conversations between two individuals, rather than simple and short exchanges.
Users can categorize messages and enable acceptance codes for conversations to enhance privacy.
